fraud_flags.title: Duplicate-account ring
fraud_flags.detail: 8 sign-ups with code FREEKX share 2 device fingerprints and 1 IP range within 3 hours.
fraud_flags.action_taken: All 8 referred accounts blocked. Referrer blocked and earnings suspended. No commission had accrued.

fraud_flags.title: Suspicious referral spike
fraud_flags.detail: 38 sign-ups with code KINGDAN in 48 hours, against a 30-day average of 0.6 per day. None of the 38 has paid.

fraud_flags.title: Refunded transaction reversed a commission
fraud_flags.detail: A $50.00 Pro room payment was refunded inside the 14-day hold. The $2.00 referral share was reversed with a new ledger entry; the original record is kept.

fraud_flags.title: Abnormal conversion pattern
fraud_flags.detail: 6 of 6 referred users paid within 11 minutes of signing up, each buying the cheapest $10 resource once and never returning.

fraud_flags.title: Referred accounts blocked
fraud_flags.detail: 3 accounts referred by @metals_mo were blocked for multi-accounting. The referrer was not involved.
